label: Sense-mixing control: mover priority read as PRIOR_4 excludes reciprocal moving
paraphrase: Logical control, no premises: for any beings, respects, InAct, InPotency, MovesIn and CanBeWithout, if priority from actual moving (the shape of 6ca87431: whatever, in act in r, moves a distinct thing in potency in r is prior to it) is read with PRIOR_4, then no two distinct beings each move the other in this way. PRIOR_4 is asymmetric by definition, so the conflated reading excludes a case that respect-indexed priority in act admits. A fact about the conflated reading, not a claim about which beings move each other.
